spawndoctor.anchor.none: No block anchored yet - sneak-right-click the block you want to check.
spawndoctor.jei.probe.what: Answers one question: would this mob spawn at this block? It replays Minecraft's real spawn pipeline and names the rule that rejected it.
spawndoctor.jei.probe.anchor: Sneak-right-click a block to anchor it. You have to stand next to a block to point at it, and standing there blocks spawns by itself - so anchor, then walk away.
spawndoctor.jei.probe.read: Right-click anywhere to read the anchored block. Pick a mob by name; the choice sticks, so checking a whole room costs one selection.
spawndoctor.jei.probe.why: Green means it can spawn. Red means it never will here. Yellow means only something temporary is stopping it - a full mob cap, or you standing too close.
